title: OLMo 2 32B: First fully open model to outperform GPT 3.5 and GPT 4o mini
paper_type_zh: 前沿模型发布说明与数据披露账本
best_for_zh: 需要审计开放权重模型的阶段化数据、RLVR 反馈边界与来源权利的研究者
one_line: Ai2's OLMo 2 32B release links its data, weights, and recipe, and discloses SFT filtering, five-completion math majority selection, on-policy preference data, and GRPO-RLVR task families, while leaving reward implementation and complete provenance/audit details unresolved.
Ai2 的 OLMo 2 32B 发布链接了数据、权重和 recipe，并披露 SFT 过滤、五次 completion 的数学多数选择、on-policy 偏好数据和 GRPO-RLVR 任务族；reward 实现与完整来源/审计细节仍未解决。
why: It is an unusually inspectable frontier model release: readers can distinguish released mixtures and checkpoints from the still-unresolved generator, reward, provenance, licence, and contamination details required to reproduce or audit the entire 32B post-training path.
inclusion_reason: A high-disclosure open-weight frontier release that names and links pretraining, mid-training, SFT, preference, and RLVR artifacts, while also disclosing a concrete synthetic-date filter, five-sample math majority selection, task families, and GRPO use for the 32B RLVR stage.

title: Problem
问题
html:
An open-weight model can link weights, code, and several dataset viewers while still leaving its full post-training path impossible to reconstruct. Auditing a 32B release requires separating the existence of released artifacts from the source allocation, synthetic-trace authoring, preference construction, reward implementation, licensing, split, and contamination evidence behind a particular checkpoint.

Ai2's OLMo 2 32B release offers a strong public release surface: it links base and instruct checkpoints, OLMo-core, pretraining and mid-training mixtures, an SFT mix, an on-policy preference mix, and an RLVR mix. The same materials leave important boundaries unresolved, especially item-level provenance, the GRPO reward/parser contract, and uniform source rights.

开放权重模型可以链接权重、代码和多个数据查看器，却仍无法重建完整后训练路径。审计一个 32B 发布需要区分：已发布 artifact 的存在，与特定 checkpoint 背后的来源分配、合成 trace 作者、偏好构造、reward 实现、许可证、切分和污染证据。

Ai2 的 OLMo 2 32B 发布具有很强的公开发布表面：它链接了 base 和 instruct checkpoint、OLMo-core、预训练和中训练混合、SFT mix、on-policy preference mix 与 RLVR mix。同一批材料也留下重要边界，尤其是逐条来源谱系、GRPO reward/parser 合约与统一来源权利。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
OLMo 2 32B is an Ai2 technical release whose disclosed 32B path combines OLMo-Mix-1124 pretraining, Dolmino mid-training, then SFT, DPO, and GRPO-based RLVR. The release says the 32B base model is trained for 1.5 epochs up to 6T tokens. It publicly links the relevant model, code, and selected data artifacts rather than only naming them.

The data object is partly inspectable. The SFT viewer exposes 866K train records with id, messages, and source; the RLVR viewer exposes 29.9K train records with messages, ground_truth, dataset, constraint_type, and constraint. The preference mix is also released, but the checked card does not establish its complete chosen/rejected schema.

The central Track 12 point is the difference between linked viewers and a full disclosure ledger. A viewer can substantiate selected records and fields, but it does not by itself establish source-to-stage allocation, synthetic generator identity, preference lineage, production reward implementation, or run-level reproducibility.

OLMo 2 32B 是一项 Ai2 技术发布，其公开的 32B 路径结合 OLMo-Mix-1124 预训练、Dolmino 中训练，然后进行 SFT、DPO 和基于 GRPO 的 RLVR。发布说明称 32B base model 训练 1.5 个 epoch、最多 6T token。它公开链接了相关模型、代码和选定数据 artifact，而不只是点名它们。

数据对象可被部分检查。SFT 查看器显示 866K 个 train 记录，字段为 id、messages 和 source；RLVR 查看器显示 29.9K 个 train 记录，字段为 messages、ground_truth、dataset、constraint_type 和 constraint。preference mix 也已发布，但已检查卡片没有建立其完整 chosen/rejected schema。

Track 12 的核心在于区分已链接查看器与完整披露账本。查看器可以证实选定记录和字段，但本身不能建立来源到阶段的分配、合成 generator 身份、偏好谱系、生产 reward 实现或运行级可复现性。

title: Method
方法
html:
The release identifies OLMo-Mix-1124 as a 3.9T-token pretraining mixture from DCLM, Dolma, StarCoder, and Proof Pile II. Dolmino mid-training is reported as 843B tokens of quality-filtered resampled OLMo-Mix documents, educational/math/academic material absent from OLMo-Mix, and synthetic plus human-generated instruction data. The checked materials do not establish a record-level source-to-stage allocation for the 32B run.

For post-training, 32B filters SFT instructions and chosen preference responses that mention a synthetic-generation date cutoff. Persona MATH and Grade School Math retain prompt/completion groups only when a majority vote is reached over five completions. The producing models, prompts, sampling settings, exact thresholds beyond this rule, and retained/rejected trace mapping are unknown.

Ai2 states that it uses high-quality instructions for SFT, on-policy preference data for DPO, and GRPO RLVR for GSM8K, IFEval, and MATH prompts. Ground-truth and constraint fields in the released RLVR mix support an answer/constraint data object, but the answer parser, task rewards, reward aggregation, calibration, GRPO rollouts, environment/harness configuration, and checkpoint-selection procedure are not established by the checked release.

发布说明将 OLMo-Mix-1124 识别为一个 3.9T-token 预训练混合，来源包括 DCLM、Dolma、StarCoder 和 Proof Pile II。Dolmino 中训练被报告为 843B token，由经质量过滤并重新采样的 OLMo-Mix 文档、OLMo-Mix 未含的教育/数学/学术材料以及合成和人工生成的指令数据组成。已检查材料没有建立 32B 运行的记录级来源到阶段分配。

在后训练中，32B 会过滤提到合成生成日期截止点的 SFT instruction 和 chosen preference response。Persona MATH 和 Grade School Math 只保留五次 completion 中达到多数票的 prompt/completion 组。产生模型、prompt、采样设置、除此规则外的精确阈值以及保留/拒绝 trace 映射均为 unknown。

Ai2 表示其使用高质量 instruction 做 SFT、on-policy preference data 做 DPO，并对 GSM8K、IFEval 和 MATH prompt 使用 GRPO RLVR。已发布 RLVR mix 中的 ground-truth 与 constraint 字段支持一个答案/约束数据对象，但已检查发布材料没有建立 answer parser、任务 reward、reward 聚合、校准、GRPO rollout、环境/harness 配置或 checkpoint 选择程序。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
Ai2's release directly links base, SFT, DPO, and instruct checkpoints; pretraining, mid-training, SFT, preference, and RLVR datasets; and OLMo-core. The model and code are Apache 2.0. The linked SFT and RLVR viewers expose the stated train sizes and record fields, so this is evidence of selected inspectable post-training artifacts rather than a purely narrative claim.

The licensing evidence is mixed at the data level. OLMo-Mix, Dolmino, and the RLVR card show ODC-BY; the preference-mix card says ODC-BY-1.0 while also listing subset-specific licences and some non-commercial portions. Thus, an open model/code licence and publicly viewable data artifacts do not establish one uniform commercial or redistribution right for every source.

Ai2 also documents evaluation-tooling and formatting/extraction caveats for selected family comparisons. That disclosure is relevant to interpreting reported evaluation deltas, but it does not show that 32B's data recipe or reward process alone caused the results.

Ai2 的发布直接链接 base、SFT、DPO 和 instruct checkpoint；预训练、中训练、SFT、preference 和 RLVR 数据集；以及 OLMo-core。模型和代码为 Apache 2.0。已链接 SFT 与 RLVR 查看器暴露了所述 train 规模和记录字段，因此这证明的是可检查的部分后训练 artifact，而不是纯叙述性主张。

数据层面的许可证证据是混合的。OLMo-Mix、Dolmino 和 RLVR 卡片显示 ODC-BY；preference-mix 卡片说明为 ODC-BY-1.0，同时列出子集特定许可证及部分非商业内容。因此，开放的模型/代码许可证和可公开查看的数据 artifact 并不能建立每个来源统一的商业或再分发权利。

Ai2 还记录了所选家族比较中的评估工具与格式/提取注意事项。该披露与解读报告的评估差异有关，但不能表明结果只由 32B 数据配方或 reward 过程造成。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
OLMo 2 32B is notable for linking a broad artifact chain across pretraining, mid-training, SFT, on-policy preference, RLVR, checkpoints, and core code. It also gives concrete 32B-specific disclosures: a synthetic-date filter, five-completion majority selection for specified math data, and GRPO RLVR task families.

For this atlas, the important novelty is not a blanket claim of openness. It is the ability to audit several release layers separately: model/code licensing, data-card fields, mix-level licences, synthetic-data construction rules, and the remaining absence of a complete reward and provenance contract. That makes it a useful disclosure-limited frontier case rather than a fully reconstructed recipe.

OLMo 2 32B 的特点在于链接了跨预训练、中训练、SFT、on-policy preference、RLVR、checkpoint 和核心代码的广泛 artifact 链。它还给出具体的 32B 披露：合成日期过滤、针对指定数学数据的五次 completion 多数选择，以及 GRPO RLVR 任务族。

对本图谱而言，重要的新意不是笼统宣称开放，而是能够分别审计多个发布层：模型/代码许可证、数据卡字段、mix 级许可证、合成数据构造规则，以及完整 reward 与来源合约仍然缺失。这使其成为一个有用但受披露限制的前沿案例，而不是完整重建的 recipe。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
This Card intentionally keeps arxiv: null. Ai2's 32B release links arXiv:2501.00656 as supporting OLMo 2 family context, but the checked family report is not titled as a 32B-specific paper; assigning it as the 32B release's arXiv identifier would be an inference.

The linked viewers do not establish complete item-level provenance. Synthetic generator identities, prompts, human contribution, exact source allocation, preference chosen/rejected mapping, raw majority-vote completions, filters/yields, training weights, and run/checkpoint identities remain incomplete or unknown.

The GRPO RLVR release identifies task families and exposes ground-truth/constraint fields, but not the production parser, per-task reward implementation, aggregation, calibration, reward-error analysis, rollout logs, or environment/harness pins. No 32B-specific decontamination or benchmark-overlap method/results are established in the checked materials, and data rights remain mixed across preference subsets.

本 Card 有意保持 arxiv: null。Ai2 的 32B 发布链接 arXiv:2501.00656 作为支持性的 OLMo 2 家族背景，但已检查家族报告并非以 32B 专属论文为标题；将其指定为 32B 发布的 arXiv 标识将构成推断。

已链接查看器没有建立完整的逐条来源谱系。合成 generator 身份、prompt、人工贡献、精确来源分配、preference chosen/rejected 映射、原始多数投票 completion、过滤/产出、训练权重和运行/checkpoint 身份仍不完整或为 unknown。

GRPO RLVR 发布标识了任务族并暴露 ground-truth/constraint 字段，但没有生产 parser、逐任务 reward 实现、聚合、校准、reward 错误分析、rollout 日志或环境/harness pin。已检查材料没有建立 32B 专属去污染或 benchmark 重叠方法/结果，且 preference 子集的数据权利仍然混合。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Use this Card to distinguish three levels of evidence: an official release link, a data viewer exposing selected fields and records, and a reproducible construction or feedback contract. OLMo 2 32B is strong at the first two levels, while several ingredients needed for the third remain unresolved.

For post-training curation, it provides concrete objects to track: SFT messages/source, RLVR ground truth and constraints, on-policy preferences, date-cutoff filtering, and five-completion majority selection. The Card also identifies what cannot be assumed from those objects, especially GRPO reward behavior and source rights.

The linked artifacts can support record inspection and research reproduction of released components. They should not be represented as proof of a uniform licence, complete dataset provenance, fully specified RLVR, or end-to-end 32B checkpoint reproduction.

使用本 Card 时，应区分三层证据：官方发布链接、暴露选定字段和记录的数据查看器，以及可复现的构造或反馈合约。OLMo 2 32B 在前两层很强，但构成第三层所需的若干成分仍未解决。

对后训练整理而言，它提供了具体对象：SFT 的 messages/source、RLVR 的 ground truth 和 constraint、on-policy preference、日期截止过滤和五次 completion 多数选择。Card 同时指出不能从这些对象中假设的内容，尤其是 GRPO reward 行为与来源权利。

已链接 artifact 可支持记录检查和对已发布组件的研究复现，但不应被表述为统一许可证、完整数据集来源、完全规定的 RLVR 或端到端 32B checkpoint 复现的证据。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Keep arxiv: null: the linked OLMo 2 family report is verified context, not a 32B-specific citation assignment.
  • Separate the released SFT viewer (866K train records) and RLVR viewer (29.9K train records) from unpinned record-level provenance and production run allocation.
  • Preserve the concrete filters: synthetic-date-cutoff mentions are removed, and specified math data requires majority agreement across five completions.
  • Record GRPO RLVR only as disclosed for GSM8K, IFEval, and MATH; parser, reward, calibration, rollout count, and harness are not established.
  • Do not extend Apache 2.0 model/code terms to every data subset: preference data contains subset-specific and some non-commercial terms.

• 保持 arxiv: null：已链接 OLMo 2 家族报告是已核验的背景，不是 32B 专属引用分配。
  • 将已发布 SFT 查看器（866K train 记录）和 RLVR 查看器（29.9K train 记录）与未固定的逐条来源谱系和生产运行分配分开。
  • 保留具体过滤规则：删除提及合成日期截止点的内容；指定数学数据需要五次 completion 中的多数一致。
  • 仅按披露将 GRPO RLVR 记录为用于 GSM8K、IFEval 和 MATH；parser、reward、校准、rollout 数和 harness 尚未建立。
  • 不要把 Apache 2.0 模型/代码条款延伸至每个数据子集：preference 数据包含子集特定且部分非商业条款。
